item.title: U.S. Olympic Cross-Country Skiing Legend Jessie Diggins Calls It a Career
item.description: US cross-country skiing icon Jessie Diggins said goodbye to Olympic competition, after finishing fifth in her final Winter Games race. The post U.S. Olympic Cross-Country Skiing Legend Jessie Diggins Calls It a Career appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Eileen Gu Becomes Most Decorated Olympic Freestyle Skier in History
item.description: Closing out the 2026 Winter Olympics with gold in the women's halfpipe, Chinese freestyle skier Eileen Gu boasts the most Olympic medals in the sport's history. The post Eileen Gu Becomes Most Decorated Olympic Freestyle Skier in History appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Iowa Women’s Basketball Upsets Michigan 62-44 in Late-Season Surge
item.description: No. 13 Iowa basketball is rolling, defeating No. 6 Michigan 62-44 on Sunday in a push to finish second in the 2025/26 Big Ten standings. The post Iowa Women’s Basketball Upsets Michigan 62-44 in Late-Season Surge appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: WNBA Updates Housing, Fails to Shift Revenue Sharing in Latest CBA Offer
item.description: With the 2026 season fast approaching, the WNBA dropped another CBA deal on Friday as the league and union continue to negotiate. The post WNBA Updates Housing, Fails to Shift Revenue Sharing in Latest CBA Offer appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: Arsenal Advances to FA Cup Quarterfinals Despite Olivia Smith Injury Scare
item.description: Arsenal defeated Bristol City 3-0 in the Women's FA Cup fifth round, despite forward Olivia Smith getting stretchered off after a head knock. The post Arsenal Advances to FA Cup Quarterfinals Despite Olivia Smith Injury Scare appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: UConn Basketball Coach Geno Auriemma Makes AP Poll History
item.description: Legendary UConn boss Geno Auriemma added another record to his resume this week, boasting the most career appearances in the AP women's basketball poll. The post UConn Basketball Coach Geno Auriemma Makes AP Poll History appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: WNBA Triggers Revenue Sharing for First Time as Season-Delay CBA Deadline Looms
item.description: The WNBA hit financial thresholds to invoke revenue sharing for the first time in history in the 2025 season, with the news coming as the league sets a hard CBA deadline. The post WNBA Triggers Revenue Sharing for First Time as Season-Delay CBA Deadline Looms appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: US Ski Star Lindsey Vonn Escaped Leg Amputation After Olympic Crash
item.description: US skier Lindsey Vonn took to social media on Monday to offer details on her Olympic injury, including how doctors saved her from a possible leg amputation. The post US Ski Star Lindsey Vonn Escaped Leg Amputation After Olympic Crash appeared first on Just Women's Sports.

item.title: US Star Naomi Girma Sends Blues to FA Cup Quarterfinals with 1st Chelsea Goal
item.description: USWNT star Naomi Girma played hero for Chelsea FC on Sunday, scoring her 1st-ever goal with the Blues to send the WSL club to next month's 2026 FA Cup quarterfinals.
